records.found: On 2026-11-05 Geroscience published an observational registry study of 11,474 US kidney transplant recipients (4,885 on rapamycin) that saw no meaningful survival gain on rapamycin (median survival age 64.6 against 64.3 years). Observational, in transplant patients on rapamycin for transplant reasons.
